title: Review of c36's condensate food chain: S, I, D and X replicate on fresh seed 5 (65 persistent prey splits, generation 3, vs 1 and generation 1 in the predator-free twin; prey count 141 vs 223 at t=2000), but the predator dies out by t~4400 and all reproduction happens in the recovery window
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 5 and its matched predator-free twin (pred_on=0), to t=20000 (twice the claim's duration). From smoothed noise ~230 prey droplets and a few predator patches form; predator patches spread through the prey (t=800-3500) and go extinct by t~4400. Prey fall to 141 droplets at t=2000 and recover to 177 by fission into the cleared, fuel-rich space: labkit's prey species gives 65 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.36; splits.py finds 68 splits, 67 of them fuel splits (dumbbell fissions into equal daughters, U-shaped and crescent divisions; splits.png) and 1 bite. The twin stays a frozen emulsion of 223 droplets with 1 persistent split, generation 1. All persistent splits fall at t=900-5700; after the predators die the prey array freezes for the remaining 14000 time units.

predator-free twin: 1 persistent split, gen 1, 223 droplets frozen

controls_run.X: nopred/seed5 (pred_on=0, same seed, grid and duration)

verdicts.limitation: One epidemic, not an ecology: on seed 5 the predator dies out by t~4400 and the prey never divide again in the remaining 15600 time units, so reproduction is a transient response to cleared space and fuel, the known fuel-starvation fission of active droplets. The positive effect of prey on predators holds by construction (predator material is made only from prey) and predators have no persistent splits, so X is shown for the prey side only. labkit's predator species reports up to 159 components in the predator-free twin, which are segmentation noise of the near-zero predator field. No dt/2 or resolution test.
